results.comment: Started April 11, 2020 (Posted April 15)  Day 1: ✅it was really hard done it first time (I have to split the Threading needles into 5 each arm) jackknives was hell Day 2: ✅my body was really sore,  Day 3: ✅more sore than before jackknives is still hard. Day 4: ✅I did the needles as the video says Day 5: ✅when I did the first exercise my abdomen hurts, it’s really getting hard in terms of motivation.😞 Day 6: ✅  Day 7: ✅ jackknives is still difficult I don’t know if my form is right but i did needles real good. Day 8: ✅I might change jackknives to something else. Day 9: ✅form is good, for jackknives I brought my legs closer instead of the original. Day 10: ✅ My mind always thinks I have to do this everyday.  Day 11: ✅ halfway done  Day 12: ✅ did it in the morning instead of the usual afternoon.  Day 13: ✅ almost missed it did it at night but did more reps Day 14: ✅ for some reason, I hate doing the 2nd exercise Day 15: ✅ lasted 45 minutes Day 16: ✅ I woke up 8:30 pm but did it until 9:00 I’m really scared that tomorrow I’ll miss it.  Day 17:  ✅ did it noon. My form on all exercises was really nice except jackknives. I really felt all my abdominal muscles the whole time. Day 18: ✅ best day for me. 7 sets of heels to heaven, x man crunch and stationary bikes. 5 sets of cross step planks, needles, and jackknives. Took an hour. Day 19: ✅ So tired. But it felt good.  Day 20: ✅ same as yesterday 45 minutes. Day 21: ✅  Day 22: ✅ the hardest fr I did 5,3,5,3,3,5 in order of the exercise. Did a 1:11 seconds plank at the end  Note: Started on Day 8 i change the time to 45 seconds. On day 13 I’m doing additional 10 seconds plank after needles. On day 15 I started adding a minute plank to end my exercise.  End Date: May 2, 2020  Final Thoughts: Can’t believe I did it. First 5 days were the hardest in terms of motivation, my body was really sore but as my body got used to it it doesn’t hurt anymore. My suggestion for those who want to do this is buy a gym/yoga mat when doing this, I did all of this on a hard wood floor and man I got bruises on my elbows lol. For the first half I think I did it mostly afternoon before dinner. However, I think it’s the best to do it before lunch or mornings. In addition to the exercise I brisk walk 5 miles atleast 3 days a week. My belly definitely was flatter I have 4 abs 2 were visible the other 2 have lines on it but I have to flex it to be visible. I will definitely keep doing this until before fall classes starts. I’ll give an update here by end of August. I’m really glad I did something productive in this quarantine period. I definitely got stronger and really helped me develop my discipline.
